name: megapose
description: A large-scale benchmark for instance-level 6D object pose estimation and detection, providing images and ground-truth object poses across many scenes and objects. It is used to evaluate algorithms' robustness to clutter, occlusion, and varying lighting, supporting standardized pose-error metrics and challenge-style evaluation. The dataset is part of the BOP ecosystem and is commonly used in robotics and vision research.
reputation: Well-regarded within the 6D pose estimation and BOP community as a standard benchmark for pose accuracy under challenging conditions.
